acceptance_criteria.statement: Browse/apply actions never debit credits and remain available with zero-credit balance.
Selected-tasker accept flow uses 15-minute timer and debits credits exactly once on accepted lead unlock.
Customer retains free selection agency across eligible applicants regardless of ranking position.
Decline/timeout creates no debit, prompts select-next-applicant flow, and prevents stale auto-unlock.
Customer cancel after unlock triggers exact credit refund transaction linked to booking.
Lead unlock pricing is versioned by category/district/effective window with minimum start value enforcement.
Application cap default is 10 and admin-configurable; cap violations return deterministic domain error.
Tasker analytics exposes success-rate and unlock-conversion metrics on trailing 28-day window.
